fields.label: Intro paragraph
fields.value: Being open about fees is part of our commitment to honesty. We want you to understand the cost of your care before you decide to go ahead, and we are always happy to talk through your options, including ways to spread payments over time.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Get our full 2026 price list, with the fees for our most common treatments, from check-ups and cleans to restorative and cosmetic care. Enter your details and we'll send it straight to you.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Because every mouth is different, the final cost of your treatment depends on your individual needs. After your examination, we will provide a written treatment plan and quote so you know what to expect.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We accept most private health insurance benefits using HICAPS, so you can claim on the spot and pay only the gap. No manual lodgement needed.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: Precision Dental is a preferred provider for {{site:preferredFunds}}. Members of these funds may receive higher rebates on eligible treatments, depending on their level of cover. If you are with another fund, please ask us about your policy, and we will help where we can.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We accept EFTPOS, Visa, Mastercard, American Express and cash.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: DentiCare offers interest-free payment plans for dental treatment between $3,000 and $12,000. A 20% deposit is paid before treatment starts, and the balance is spread over 12 to 18 months, with weekly, fortnightly or monthly payments. A small set-up fee applies. Eligibility criteria, terms and conditions apply. Our team can explain how the plan works and help you apply.

sections.label: Accessing Your Superannuation with My SuperCare

fields.label: Heading
fields.value: Accessing Your Superannuation with My SuperCare

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: My SuperCare helps Australians access necessary dental treatment by easing the financial pressure of its cost. It works with the Australian Taxation Office under strict guidelines, and the application process is simple, so you can get the treatment you need sooner. For some patients, early release of superannuation on compassionate grounds may be an option for treatment such as dental implants, root canal therapy, gum treatment, and restorative treatment for tooth decay, erosion and other damage using composite resin fillings or crowns. Treatment that helps restore everyday function, such as eating and speaking comfortably, may be considered. My SuperCare is an independent service that guides eligible patients through the application process. Eligibility is determined under Australian Taxation Office criteria, and approval is not assured. We recommend seeking independent financial advice before accessing your super.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: The Medicare Child Dental Benefits Schedule provides benefits towards basic dental services, such as check-ups, X-rays, cleans and fillings, for eligible children and teenagers. Our team can help you confirm your child's eligibility and remaining benefit before their appointment. Ask our team how CDBS billing works at our practice.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: We welcome eligible Department of Veterans' Affairs (DVA) patients. Please bring your Veteran Card to your appointment and our team will explain what's covered.

fields.label: Paragraph
fields.value: If you would like to understand the likely cost of a particular treatment, such as Invisalign or dental implants, please contact our team. We are always happy to help.
